questions.label: Underlying agreement
questions.ask: Which agreement does the AI Addendum amend?
questions.fills: Cover: Agreement. Customer and signature block use the clickthrough model: Customer is the company or person who accepts this AI Addendum, effective on the date Customer first accepts.

questions.label: AI features
questions.ask: What do the product's AI features do?
options: Generate text or code from prompts
An assistant or agent that takes actions
questions.fills: Template fit and AI Acceptable Use Policy scope
questions.codebase: LLM SDK imports (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel AI SDK), prompt templates, tool definitions.

questions.label: Training data
questions.ask: Which customer data may you use to train models?
questions.fills: Cover: Training Data (must agree with the terms model-training fact)

questions.label: Training purpose
questions.ask: If training is allowed, who may the trained models serve?

questions.label: Before training
questions.ask: What must happen to data before it is used for training?
options: No extra steps, or no training
questions.fills: Cover: Training Restrictions ('None' when no extra steps)

questions.label: Product improvement
questions.ask: What limits apply when you use Input and Output to improve the product (not models)?
options: Improvements from a customer's data only benefit that customer
questions.fills: Cover: Improvement Restrictions ('None' when no limits)

questions.label: AI indemnities
questions.ask: Who defends against claims about AI Input or Output?
options: We cover claims that Output infringes (standard wording)
We cover Output claims; the customer covers Input claims
questions.fills: Cover: Covered Claims (delete the row when none)

questions.label: AI use policy
questions.ask: Which rules govern how users interact with the AI features?
options: A separate AI use policy (give the URL)
questions.fills: Cover: AI Acceptable Use Policy (delete the row when none)
questions.codebase: Existing acceptable use or AI policy pages.
